subject: Boa Health — hosting evidence and audit action plan
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@boahealth.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@boahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: hosting route & audit evidence — next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to sync through Boa Health's regulatory constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have an action plan to share with your procurement and security teams.

Summary (from the call)
- Primary goal: run PHI-containing inference for patient support workflows with a BAA and evidence that production environment meets SOC 2 controls.
- Hosting options you asked us to qualify: Hosted API (Redwood cloud), Dedicated reserved capacity, Private (VPC/on-prem).
- Immediate procurement ask: confirmation of preferred hosting path and list of required artifacts to include with the procurement packet.

Proposed next steps (my recommended order)
1) We share a compact evidence pack (BAA draft + SOC2 evidence checklist + network diagram) so your security can triage. (I attached a starter pack.)
2) You confirm whether a Private VPC or Dedicated pool is required for the initial rollout (if the answer is Private, we will treat the timeline and onboarding differently).
3) If Private is required, we will provision a technical scoping call with our Private deploy team and network engineer.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday which hosting mode your security/procurement is leaning toward? If it's helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up with procurement + security next week.

Attachments: BAA-draft-BoaHealth-v1.docx (DRAFT), SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (template), redwood-network-diagram.pdf (high-level)

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosting route & audit evidence — next steps

Michael — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying points from our side after an internal sync: 

1) For initial pilot (patient messaging, no billing integrations), our risk team is OK evaluating Redwood Hosted with a signed BAA + SOC 2 evidence. If we see traction, we will require either Dedicated reserved or Private VPC for production processing of PHI.
2) Critical procurement asks: copy of BAA, SOC 2 Type II report or at minimum the evidence checklist that maps controls to artifacts, network diagram showing egress restrictions, and an expected SLA for latency and uptime.
3) Timeline: procurement needs artifact packet by Friday COB; if we decide Dedicated or Private, we will open a scoping RFP the following week.

Let's tentatively schedule a 30-minute call Thursday to confirm artifacts. Elena will coordinate times.

—Samir
Director of IT Security | Boa Health

- Neha: can you assemble a minimal SOC2 evidence mapping and call out any known gaps for Hosted mode vs Dedicated/Private (we want to be transparent).

Samir — per your request I attached the draft pack (same three files). If procurement wants a sealed doc (PDF) or DocuSign, let me know. I'll also include a short note that explains typical fallback flow (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private) and expected lead times.

Proposed meeting: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 10:00-10:30 PT — Elena, can you confirm?

Thanks all,
Michael

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosting route & audit evidence — next steps

Hi Samir / Michael — following up with the evidence checklist and short notes on differences by hosting path. Attached: SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (prefilled) with columns: control, artifact, current_status, expected_delivery. High-level notes below: 

Hosting mode differences (short)
- Hosted API (Redwood cloud): fastest onboarding. We can provide SOC 2 Type II report, mapping file (we populate control mappings), BAA template, network egress IP ranges, and sample logging/audit extracts. Typical gap: customers that require VPC isolation for PHI sometimes consider Hosted insufficient even with BAA.
- Dedicated reserved capacity: same artifacts as Hosted plus dedicated GPU pools (logical separation), customer-specific tenancy, and stricter data retention/rotation options. Lead time: ~4–6 weeks for capacity provisioning depending on region.
- Private VPC / on-prem: full network-level isolation, customer-managed keys, and ability to ship on-prem package. Lead time: 8–12+ weeks with network provisioning and security review.

Requested artifacts we will deliver by Friday COB (per Samir's note):
- Signed BAA (DRAFT)
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) OR populated checklist mapping controls to artifacts
- Network diagram (redwood-network-diagram.pdf) showing egress and peering options
- Example logging export (sample-audit.log) — note: will be redacted/sample only

Caveats / action items for procurement
- If you require encrypted HSM key management or on-prem key custody, that drives us to Private deployment.
- If your risk team requires continuous SOC 2 monitoring with quarterly evidence uploads, we should document the cadence in the SOW.

I will upload the filled-in checklist to the Drive link and send a redacted SOC2 report.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (prefilled)

Thanks — this is exactly what procurement/security needed. Quick confirmations: 

- We will accept Hosted API for the pilot provided we receive the BAA draft and the SOC2 checklist by COB Friday. Procurement will review and revert with any minor redlines.
- For production, we are likely to require Dedicated reserved capacity or Private VPC depending on SOW and key custody options. Procurement will include the Dedicated capacity option in the draft RFP.
- Confirmed meeting: Thu 02 Sep 2026 10:00 PT — sending invite now.

Please make sure the SOC2 checklist marks the following artifacts as high priority: logging exports (application + infra), backup/retention policy, access control lists, and key rotation policy.

Elena Ruiz
VP, Procurement | Boa Health
elena.ruiz@boahealth.com
